It features a large bony frill at the rear of the head, two prominent brow horns, and a smaller nasal horn. The forelimbs appear shorter than the hindlimbs, creating a sloping back. The image appears to be a photograph of a physical object rather than a direct AI generation, though it is being evaluated as an AI-generated image for conformance.
